result.summary: Both photo defects share ONE evidence-proven root cause, and it is a Server read-model defect, not a Native one. The Server photos read projects a duplicate legacy-adapted Sep 19 session (five legacy progressPhotos rows written by the evidence-review confirm action, whose imagePath is the DNG ORIGINAL) that sorts ahead of the canonical Sep 19 session (whose views use the JPEG derivative). Native takes it as the latest set. Its DNG images hit the media route content-type allowlist and 404 (issue 1: permanent Retry), and photo-event for its legacy session id finds no briefing and 404s (issue 2: false 'being prepared'). Proof: object HEAD shows all ten Sep 19 objects healthy; production logs show every photo-event read in the window used the legacy session id with zero rows; the legacy session fingerprint recomputed from the five legacy rows equals that id exactly. Per the task, a Server correction is required and no Server deploy or production write is authorized, so the Build 48 release path was stopped. Issue 3 fix (8256db4b) recovered intact (it is HEAD of the current worktree) and unchanged. No Build 48 bump, archive or upload. No production mutation.

tests.summary: No new Native code this task, so no new tests. Carried forward: PhotoBriefingTests 29/29 pass at 8256db4b (from the prior task). The Build 48 release gates were not run because the release path stopped.

review.summary: No independent review: no Build 48 candidate beyond the already-reported issue 3 commit, and the required fix for issues 1 and 2 is on the Server side.

zero_write_audit.summary: Reads only. Object-storage HEAD (no GET, no signed URLs) of 14 objects (10 Sep 19, 4 Aug 22) using the app's bindings inside the approved console path; database reads in BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY transactions with transaction_read_only=on verified, owner-scoped and bounded, then ROLLBACK; one bounded run-log read (last 3000 lines, filtered in a pipe, nothing persisted). App, component, web and worker SHA reverified before use. No credentials printed, no image bytes read, no writes.

decisions_required: Authorize a Server correction and deploy (separate task/authorization, not part of this Native task). Minimal correction: in the photo session read model (createPhotoSessionReadModels and createPhotoSessionLandingSummary), treat a legacy progressPhotos row as owned by a canonical session when its imagePath equals the canonical photo's ORIGINAL storage_path, not only its display/derivative path (add the original asset keys to the canonical asset key set). This suppresses the duplicate legacy session with no data mutation and needs a Server unit test (canonical DNG session with derivative plus a legacy row on the original must yield one session).

Decide whether Build 48 should proceed as an issue 3 only release (plus any retry-semantics hardening) once the Server fix is live, or whether Build 47 plus the Server fix is sufficient for the two photo defects and Build 48 can wait.

Optional Server hardening to authorize separately: the evidence-review confirm action should link legacy progress photo rows to the canonical session (source ids) or write the display reference, and the media route should return distinct status codes and log failures instead of masking everything as 404.
blockers: Root cause requires a Server contract correction; the task forbids silently patching Server code and authorizes no Server deploy, so the Build 48 release path (review, bump, archive, API-key upload) was stopped.
Native cannot correctly fix this: hiding or deduplicating sessions in Native would be a shadow lifecycle, and a Native Retry cannot recover a server-chosen DNG reference.
unexpected_findings: The affected 'first/latest Sep 19 image' is not the canonical Sep 19 session at all; it is a legacy-adapted duplicate whose id starts with legacy-photo-session-photo-assets and which sorts before the canonical id on equal capture date.

The canonical Sep 19 photos and derivatives are healthy: HEAD 200, content type, size and version match the database rows, and the derivatives are JPEG. The Photo Briefing renders Sep 19 photos correctly because it references the canonical derivative ids.

The five legacy rows were created 2026-09-20 15:22 to 15:23 UTC by the Confirmed Photo Session projection in the evidence-review confirm action, which stores the original storage path as imagePath. Older JPEG sessions were unaffected only because original and display references were identical.
The media route allowlist (jpeg, png, heic, webp, pdf) rejects image/x-adobe-dng, so any DNG original served for display 404s permanently.

Run logs available covered only 2026-09-21 04:04 to 06:42 UTC (current deployment); the 8 photo-event 404s at 05:19 to 05:21 UTC are inside it. Media route failures are not logged, so issue 1 rests on HEAD, the route allowlist and the deterministic session selection rather than a logged request.
backlog: Server fix for the duplicate legacy Sep 19 session (blocking issues 1 and 2), then Founder re-check on the existing Build 47.
Ship the issue 3 fix (8256db4b) in Build 48 after independent review and full gates.
Optional Native hardening: after a fresh-token second 404, show Photo unavailable rather than a Retry that cannot recover.
Prove the API-key upload path with the first real Build 48 upload (auth-check passes; cloud-signing sufficiency of the Developer role unproven).
Server hardening: distinct status codes and logging on the media route; link or suppress legacy progress photo rows at confirmation time.
recommended_next_step: Publish a new task authorizing a Server-side fix branch for the legacy-session ownership defect (unit test, review, then a separately authorized deploy from the production branch). After it is live, the Founder re-checks Progress Photos on Build 47; both defects should clear. Then run Build 48 as the issue 3 release (recover 8256db4b, gates, review, bump, archive, API-key upload).
